_comment: Teaching/lore NPC on the actor model (plan-entity-model.md chunk 3a) — formerly a statless model/npc type placed from zone.npcs, now an ordinary actor carrying an interaction block. role creature + speed 0 (PO 2026-07-27, D4): an NPC is an actor that authors no movement, not a kind of its own. Unattackable by two AUTHORED knobs (D5): faction townsfolk (friendlyToPlayers ⇒ player damage skips it) and collisionLayer 97 = PlayerStatic(1) + Viewport(32) + MobStatic(64) — solid and streamed, but deliberately NOT on Action(2), so no aura on either side can target it. interaction.range 2.0 [PLACEHOLDER] is the talk reach and sizes the one sensor. xpFactor 0 keeps it off the nameplate path; the health bar is accepted (D3). All values [PLACEHOLDER]. The support-line teacher: FirstAid early, Revive much later. ⚑ TEXT SHAPE (PO 2026-08-02, on top of the Q4/R1 tree shape): teach text is deliberately plain — teachings behind the unified 'Teach me something.' row as rows that NAME the skill directly. ⚑ QUESTS: offers and turns in `alpha-wolves-at-the-village` (plan-generic-kill-quests.md C2) behind its own root row — 'fewer wolves, fewer wounded' is the healer-shaped cull.
